tasks.short: Represent the institution at events, meetings and accreditation.

steps.what: Assemble the briefing pack for the accreditation visit.

loop.input: The accreditation request and the latest institutional extract
loop.output: A briefing pack with each figure tied to the extract
loop.check: Administrator removes any figure that is not in the extract
loop.stop: One pass. A heading with no source is left blank.
loop.why_not_simpler: The request is a letter, not a form with fixed cells

steps.what: Represent the institution at the community or campus event.
Speak in accreditation meetings with institution personnel.
Send the follow-up note agreed at the meeting.

loop.input: Notes from the event or the accreditation meeting
loop.output: A follow-up note limited to what was agreed
loop.check: Administrator edits every commitment before send
loop.stop: One draft. A promise that is not in the notes is deleted.
loop.why_not_simpler: The note has to follow the conversation, which is not a template

tasks.design: A briefing pack is drafted from the {DOCS} accreditation file and the {BI} extract, and the administrator checks every figure. The event and the accreditation meetings stay in person. The follow-up leaves {EMAIL} only after the administrator edits it to match the notes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Briefings were rebuilt from old slides, and follow-up mail was written from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: The institutional extract can be refreshed, and a bounded pass can draft a pack or a note for a person to edit.
tasks.still_hard: Being the person in the room, at a campus event or in front of an accreditation reviewer.
tasks.human_edge: Only the administrator speaks for the institution. The pack does not.
tasks.altitude: The week is still events and accreditation meetings. The pack and the follow-up are ready. Who may speak for the institution does not change.

reach.role: Property, Real Estate, and Community Association Managers
reach.task: Attend a community meeting for an estate
reach.learn: Which questions have to be answered by the person who is present

evidence.claim: Representation at an event or an accreditation meeting is presence, not a document.
A follow-up that adds a commitment the meeting did not make is worse than no note.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: preparation, attendance and the follow-up for one event or accreditation meeting. The accreditation evidence library itself is maintained elsewhere.
Structured fields: event id, figure id, source extract, commitment text. Institutional research produces the extract. If a requested figure has no source, the pack shows a blank, not an estimate.
Use the existing report views and the document store before a custom briefing tool.
unknowns: Which events the administrator must attend in person.
Who else may send a follow-up in the institution's name.
Which accreditation figures are already an official extract.
research_questions: Is the accreditation file a controlled pack or a folder of old slides?

incremental.description: Refresh the standard institutional figures used in briefing packs

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: attendance is the task and the pack is rewritten on the day. High: figures are trusted and the follow-up is a short edit. Attendance stays. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare reports on academic and institutional data.

steps.what: Extract academic and institutional data for the report.
Reconcile the extract to the official student census.
Draft the academic report and its commentary.

loop.output: Report tables plus commentary sentences tied to a figure
loop.check: Administrator deletes any sentence whose figure is not on the extract
loop.stop: One draft. A broken census row produces no sentence.
loop.why_not_simpler: Commentary is prose and has to stay inside the figures

steps.what: Review surprising academic figures with the data owner.
Publish the approved academic reports pack.

tasks.design: A saved {BI} extract from the {LMS} and the {ERP} replaces retyping. The administrator reconciles it to the student census, and a bounded pass drafts commentary only from the reconciled figures. The pack is published after the administrator has cleared surprising rows with the data owner. If the census does not match, nothing is published.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports were copied into a workbook and the commentary was written loose of the census.
tasks.enabler_now: Enrolment, finance and completion data can be extracted on a schedule when the definitions are stable.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding what a surprising figure means, and refusing commentary the extract does not support.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator clears the pack. A generated sentence is not a finding.

ambition.what: A monthly look at which programmes sit below their enrolment or progression line.

tasks.altitude: Rebuild time shrinks. A short reconciliation and the surprising-figure conversation stay. The administrator can hold a pack that does not match the census.

reach.learn: Which fields can refresh and which filters change the count

evidence.claim: An academic report can be generated from structured enrolment and finance extracts when definitions are stable.
Commentary has to be checked against the figures. A fluent sentence is not evidence.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: one recurring academic or institutional report, from extract to the published pack. Strategy narrative is a separate task.

Structured fields: period, programme id, census count, enrolment count, completion count. The student-records owner produces the census. A row that does not match is an exception, not a rounded figure.
Use the report tool's own saved report before a custom job. The side sheet is not the source.
unknowns: Which report definitions are already agreed.
Which packs are published outside the institution.
research_questions: Do programme codes match between the learning system and the census?

incremental.description: Maintain report definitions when a census rule or programme code changes

approvals.approved_version: academic report whose figures match the cleared census extract

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: definitions change and many rows need the meeting, so the extract is only a start. High: definitions are stable, commentary is a check, and the meeting is only for breaks. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Promote the university through events and industry partnerships.

steps.what: Prepare a partnership brief for the industry visit.

loop.input: The partner record and the programme sheet
loop.output: A one-page brief of what the institution can offer
loop.check: Administrator deletes any offer that is not on the programme sheet
loop.stop: One draft. An unknown partner gets a blank brief, not a guessed history.
loop.why_not_simpler: Partner history is free text and the offer has to stay inside published programmes

steps.what: Promote the university at community, state or national events.
Meet industry and secondary education partners.
Send the partnership note agreed in the meeting.

loop.output: A note of what was offered and what was asked
loop.check: Administrator edits every offer before send
loop.stop: One draft. An offer that is not in the notes is deleted.
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must follow the meeting, not a campaign template

tasks.design: The {CRM} holds the partner, and a bounded pass drafts a brief from the published programme sheet. Events and partner meetings stay in person. The note that leaves {EMAIL} is edited by the administrator and contains only what the meeting agreed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Partner meetings started from memory, and the follow-up offered things the programme sheet did not.
tasks.enabler_now: A partner record and a published programme sheet are enough to draft a brief a person checks.
tasks.still_hard: The conversation with a school or an employer, and what the administrator is willing to promise.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator makes the offer. The brief does not.

ambition.what: A one-page pathway note a named secondary school can keep after the visit.

tasks.altitude: Travel and meetings stay. The brief is ready. The administrator can refuse a note that promises more than the meeting did.

reach.task: Keep a partnership with a local organisation
reach.learn: Which promises from a meeting are safe to write down

evidence.claim: Partnership building is a meeting. A brief can prepare it and must not invent an offer.
Sending a promise the programme does not support creates work the meeting did not agree.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: one promotion event or partner meeting, from the brief to the note. Contracts that follow are a separate task.
Structured fields: partner id, programme id, offer line, meeting note id. The programme office produces the programme sheet. If a programme is missing, the brief does not describe it.
Use the contact record's own fields and mail templates before a custom campaign. Test that configuration first.
unknowns: Which partners are already on the contact record.
Who may promise a pathway to a school.
Whether secondary-school contacts have a lawful basis for mail.
research_questions: Are programme sheets stable enough to quote in a partner brief?

incremental.description: Keep programme facts on the partner brief current

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the visits are the task and briefs are rewritten. High: the programme sheet is trusted and the note is a short edit. The visits stay. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Take part in faculty and college committee meetings.

steps.what: Read the committee papers before the meeting.

loop.output: A short list of decisions asked and the page each one is on
loop.check: Administrator checks the page reference before the meeting
loop.stop: One pass. A paper with no clear ask is listed as 'read in full'.
loop.why_not_simpler: Papers mix minutes, tables and prose a fixed template does not separate

steps.what: Participate in the faculty or college committee.
Record the actions the committee assigned to this office.

loop.input: The administrator's notes from the committee
loop.output: Actions with an owner and a date, only if the notes state them
loop.check: Administrator deletes any action the notes do not contain
loop.stop: One draft. A vague note becomes no action, not a guessed task.
loop.why_not_simpler: Committee speech does not arrive as a task form

tasks.design: Before a committee, a bounded pass lists the decisions the papers ask and the page each one is on. The meeting stays in the room. Afterwards the same kind of pass turns the administrator's notes into an action list, and the administrator deletes anything the notes did not say. No minutes are published by this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Papers were long and the actions lived in a notebook.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded pass can point at pages and lift actions from notes the person already wrote.
tasks.still_hard: Taking part in the committee: the argument, the vote, the relationship with faculty.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator decides what this office actually accepted. The action list does not add duties.
tasks.altitude: The committee still takes the time. Reading is shorter and the action list is explicit. Decision rights on the committee do not change.

reach.learn: Which actions need an owner and a date before the meeting ends

evidence.claim: Committee participation is the meeting. A paper brief and an action list are the only mechanical parts.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: preparation, attendance and this office's action list. Publishing official minutes belongs to the committee secretary.
Structured fields: committee id, paper id, page, asked decision, action, owner, date. The secretary produces the papers. If a paper has no text extract, the administrator reads it whole.
Use the document store and the task list already in place before any custom reader.
unknowns: Which committees this role must attend.
Whether notes may be stored beside the official minutes.
research_questions: Are committee papers consistently filed in one store?

incremental.description: Keep the list of committees and their paper locations current

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the meeting is the task and papers are too messy to brief. High: the brief is usable and the action list is a short edit. The meeting stays. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Briefings, report extracts and committee papers arrive ready to check. Events, accreditation, partner meetings and committees still fill the week. The administrator can hold a note or a report that is not the checked version.
reach: Computer and information systems managers can reuse the census check, not the academic commentary
Social and community service managers can see which partner promises are safe to write down
skills_to_grow: Clearing a figure before it is treated as a finding
Editing a follow-up so it matches the meeting
Leaving a committee action off the list when the notes are vague
role.ambitious_version: Every external meeting starts from a checked pack, and every academic report matches the census before anyone reads the commentary.
